title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
title_cn: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
summary:
Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney.
Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Meta Platforms Inc. and others.
The company outlined the plans in job listings added to its website this week. In one, Apple said it’s seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant. The system will write code, browse the web, control apps and navigate devices on a user’s behalf, according to the post. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JPMorgan, Visa Warn of Cyberattack That Hit Outside Vendor

JPMorgan Chase & Co., Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc. said some customer information was accessed in a cyberattack on a vendor.
JPMorgan said it believes, based on an investigation so far, that hackers accessed marketing data held by an outside firm, which may include customer names and email addresses. The bank said the issue isn’t related to an outage it faced earlier this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
